sentences.key: いつものパンもねあげしてたよ。
sentences.display: いつものパンも値上(ねあ)げしてたよ。
sentences.english: Even our usual bread has gone up in price.
sentences.input: いつものぱんもねあげしてたよ。
sentences.reading_review: Reviewed original furigana and dictionary reading 値上げねあげ; no contextual particle substitutions required. Keep パン nasal mora and lexical ねあげ intact.
sentences.pronunciation_guidance: A casual observation about bread becoming more expensive. Say いつものぱんも as one phrase, then ねあげしてたよ as one connected phrase. Allow only a very brief natural boundary after も, with no dramatic pause. Keep ねあげしてたよ smooth, evenly paced and conversational; do not stretch syllables or rush the ending. 値上げ is heiban (0); use natural Tokyo intonation for its inflected phrase.
